bio.text: Becky Schwanke (listed by the Legislature as Rebecca Schwanke) has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 36 since 2025.

According to Schwanke's legislative biography, the representative lists Tok (1978 to 1991) among the Alaska communities lived in, lives in Tazlina, and has served on the Copper River School District board since 2018.

It lists a B.S. in natural resources (1998) and an M.S. in wildlife biology (2001) from the University of Alaska Fairbanks and says Schwanke is a former state wildlife biologist with the Alaska Department of Fish and Game.
